title: rag.py pack fails with FileNotFoundError in a clone that has no kb/_self directory
goal: rag.py pack and the other lookups run in a clone with no kb/_self directory: kbfacts.self_docs() returns [] when SELF_DIR is absent instead of raising FileNotFoundError, which a reader's clone of a repository whose kb/_self holds no tracked file hits (found by ST-pdtcxbap, whose check packs in such a clone)

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(["cp","-r","_tools",d]); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,os.path.join(d,"_tools","rag.py"),"pack","x"],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=d); sys.exit(1 if "FileNotFoundError" in r.stderr else 0)
